housing.text: Brown says she supports efforts to address California's shortage of affordable housing, while adding that increasing supply alone is not enough.
housing.quote: I support efforts to address the shortage of affordable housing for low- and middle-income Californians

safety.text: Brown lists investing in community-based prevention to create safer communities as a top priority.
safety.quote: investing in community-based prevention to create safer communities

health.text: Brown explicitly supports expanding state-supported health coverage, including for residents who are not citizens.
health.quote: I support expanding access to healthcare so that more Californians, including those who are not citizens, can receive the care they need.

wages.text: Bryan authored AB 247, which raised incarcerated firefighters' pay to the federal minimum wage.
wages.quote: all labor is dignified and anybody who is willing to put their lives on the line deserves our gratitude

housing.text: Bryan says he passed legislation to build affordable housing.
housing.quote: In office we have successfully passed legislation to end neighborhood oil drilling, build affordable housing, expand economic opportunity for small businesses, make lasting investments in our youth, and give voice to those who have historically been unheard.

safety.text: Bryan calls for neighborhood investments that improve safety by addressing root causes.
safety.quote: The current system drives racial inequities and exacerbates poverty. Our neighborhoods need investments that make them safer and address the root causes. Together, we can do better.

energy.text: Bryan authored AB 2716, which penalizes low-producing oil wells to shut down the Inglewood Oil Field and fund affected frontline communities.
energy.quote: Today, with Governor Newsom's signature, we will finally shut it down and establish the state's first repair fund for the frontline communities who have been organizing for years to be seen, heard, and protected.
